summary_en: This Phase 2/3 study tests 4-aminopyridine, given as FDA-approved 10 mg dalfampridine tablets, in men with prostate cancer who are having surgery to remove the prostate. The tablets are taken by mouth daily, starting the day after surgery and continuing for 2 months (60 days), with no more than 2 tablets in 24 hours, and a placebo look-alike is used for comparison. The record does not state a main outcome measure; the study aims to test whether 4-aminopyridine speeds recovery from nerve injury after the surgery.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2/3 evalúa la 4-aminopiridina, administrada como tabletas de dalfampridina de 10 mg aprobadas por la FDA, en hombres con cáncer de próstata que se someterán a la cirugía para extirpar la próstata. Las tabletas se toman por vía oral todos los días, comenzando el día después de la cirugía y continuando durante 2 meses (60 días), sin más de 2 tabletas en 24 horas, y se usa un placebo de apariencia similar para la comparación. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; el estudio busca comprobar si la 4-aminopiridina acelera la recuperación de la lesión nerviosa después de la cirugía.
who_for: Men with organ-confined, non-metastatic prostate cancer (cT1c-T2c) planning robotic bilateral nerve-sparing prostatectomy
PSA under 15 ng/mL within the last 12 months, with no adjuvant therapy expected after surgery
IIEF-5 score of 17 or higher at screening, with regular sexual activity in the prior 6 months and 12 weeks
Willing to avoid erectile dysfunction treatments until 3 months after surgery and able to give informed consent
not_for: Planned adjuvant therapy based on stage T3 or higher, positive lymph nodes, or positive surgical margins
Neoadjuvant therapy before prostatectomy, or recurrent prostate cancer
History of seizures, multiple sclerosis, stroke, or other diagnosed neurological disorder
Penile surgery other than circumcision or endoscopic urethral stricture surgery, or hypersensitivity to 4-AP
Renal impairment (calculated GFR under 60 mL/min) or use of other aminopyridine medications
